items.text: Hey, Wall Diggers!

After the last update, some players experienced crashes and game freezes. We’re really sorry about that! This patch focuses primarily on fixing those stability issues, along with a few other improvements to enemy behavior and game flow. Please make sure that you have the latest (Win. v1.0.9.357, mac v1.0.9.32) version of the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/be46aa2e773a915ce9c367c6886431d72110ee21.jpg"]
Fixed a crash that could occur when spawning enemies during wave events.
Fixed an issue where enemies could get stuck on the Wall.
Fixed an issue where some ground-based enemies wouldn’t move and would eventually self-destruct. They’ve been properly trained now - no more vanishing!
Fixed an issue where a specific enemy wouldn’t damage the spider and would fall through the ground.
Fixed a camera issue when docking to a cave during a Leviathan encounter.
Fixed a softlock that could occur when selecting a mission on the map.
Thanks so much for your patience! Keep sharing the feedback with us!

Hey, Wall Diggers!

Another patch is live! This time we’re bringing something cool to end-game content, along with balance tweaks and bug fixes based on your feedback. If you've already finished the main story – there’s more to discover! Make sure that you have the latest (Win. v1.0.6.338, Mac v1.0.6.24) version of the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/127b5fc0bcbc56a79eded04449f8c72f08d94afb.jpg"]
Added new drilling devices to the robospider garage, similar to those from the original Wall World
Added the ability to replay previous missions after completing the main story Several new special missions are also unlocked post-story
Added visual changes to some of the city’s inhabitants after the main story is completed
Added a decorative story-related element to the map after the main story is completed
Added Jill’s walking animation through the city after the main story is completed
Adjusted the amount of rubies in certain missions where the numbers were too low.
Reduced the spawn rate of Zirexes from incubators.
Improved overall balance with minor adjustments.
Fixed an issue where the Leviathan’s wall strike had an incorrect damage area.
Fixed an issue where the spider’s weapons could become stuck and continue firing on their own in certain situations
Fixed an issue where some relics didn’t convert to dust correctly in the statistics screen at the end of missions
Fixed the thermosphere generator behavior.
Fixed an issue where the resource container could disappear in caves after teleporting back to the spider.
Fixed an issue where movement was blocked if turrets were stored inside the spider.
Fixed many other minor bugs and stability issues.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/04097de8b20d1e26a0ff15509f0ae694ee828d99.gif"]
We’ve also gathered several key tips on how progression and combat mechanics work in Wall World 2 to help new players settle in more quickly.
1. Progression

Your character and the spider mecha grow stronger not only during a run. Your success primarily depends on meta-progression. Between runs, make sure to visit Jill’s Workshop for spider upgrades and the Shop for permanent hero bonuses and new tools. Don’t hoard resources without a purpose – investments always pay off in future runs.
2. Stay Hydrated

Before each run, we strongly recommend stopping by the Bar. Drinks are powerful temporary buffs for the entire expedition – for a certain amount of dust, you can gain bonuses to attack, defense, movement speed, or even resource drops. If you’re struggling with the early biomes or get overwhelmed too quickly, a couple of drinks can solve the problem.
3. New Upgrades

The second part of progression is tied to missions. “Main quests” unlock key features, new modules, and spider mecha systems. “Side quests” aren’t mandatory, but they’re your way to unlock lots of new things, including weapon types, permanent spider upgrades, and even a helpful companion.
4. Zyrexes

Tip #1 – undock the spider from the mine entrance during enemy waves to dodge attacks and defend more effectively. Don’t forget to use your machine’s abilities (missiles, saws, dodges, etc), which are purchased in Jill’s Workshop. Zyrexes inside the mines are dangerous too – the Honey Badger handles them far better than a regular drill.
5. Roguelite Element

Starting each run without temporary upgrades is part of the roguelite genre. Temporary upgrades reset, but in Wall World 2 your progress never fully disappears: every run brings new resources, every mission moves you closer to your goals, and every purchase pushes you forward. The more meta-progression you unlock, the easier your future runs will become.
As always, keep drilling, keep exploring, and keep the feedback coming!

items.text: Hey, Wall Diggers!

Thanks a ton for playing Wall World 2 and sending us your feedback! We’re carefully going through every comment, bug report and message. Some fixes are live today, and more are coming soon. This update focuses on making your journey through the Wall smoother and more balanced. Please, make sure that you have the latest (Win. v1.0.5.330, Mac v1.0.5.20) version of the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/65c44a11d711b23c336026414497e7d36fb2f01b.jpg"]
Added the drill booster device to the shop from the very beginning.
Changed the behavior of the spiked round enemy - it will no longer consume resources inside caves.
Changed evac transport timing. It now arrives 10 seconds earlier.
Rebalanced enemy waves in Region 1.
Changed wave timer behavior - it no longer progresses during combat.
Reduced the wave acceleration effect from destroying spawners.
Fixed an exploit with destructible blocks in caves.
Added new drill-enhancing cocktails for the main character.
Increased the damage dealt by the “Volcano” robospider chassis.
Increased the pickup radius for the support drone.
Fixed an issue where the spider could sometimes become unable to move.
Fixed ability icons not correctly showing their active state.
Enabled skipping dialogues with the left mouse button.
Fixed several tutorial-related issues.
Fixed an issue when background textures could disappear in the "meat" biome.
Fixed localization errors in several languages.
Fixed a targeting issue for “Hive” robospider chassis drones during the Leviathan fight in Region 6.
Fixed several sound glitches.
Fixed an issue where the resource container could pick up a relic module.
And many other minor fixes.

Also, big news! Wall World 2 is now fully Steam Deck Verified. From the start, the game has included in-game settings tailored for Steam Deck users with optimized controls and adaptive UI. So if you're playing on Deck, you're all set to drill in comfort anytime, anywhere.
More improvements are on the way - we’re already working on the next update. Keep sending us your feedback, and thanks for helping us make Wall World 2 even better.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467710/Wall_World_2/"]

Hey, Wall Diggers! Thanks a ton for diving into the Wall World 2 playtest and sharing your thoughts with us. We’ve been reading your feedback, and while big changes are coming closer to the demo, here’s a quick update (v166) to improve your current experience.
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45721003/54191d4f92d00311ebff8410c816d33bbbcf45cb.jpg"]

Changed how the Pulsar works. It’s no longer a drill replacement. It now requires a charge before firing, as originally intended. The Pulsar is meant to help you take down Zirexes and spawners, not for drilling through rocks. Don’t worry though – there’s more than enough resources in the mines to power up your drill.
Fixed a layering issue with the special resource from spawners. It was hiding behind the spawner, but now it's clearly visible.
Fixed a rare crash that could occur in a specific scene for some players.

We know the turbo-mining Pulsar was a wild ride, and honestly, it was fun. Thanks for the laughs, the clips, and for helping us make the game better. Keep drilling through the Wall and sending us your feedback!
